Keyword "lore" (lgit: info/zones/31/lore)
This region lies just south of Esgaroth (Long Lake) and east of the dark eaves
of Mirkwood, where the River Running (Celduin) flows south toward the Sea of
Rhûn. Historically, this area serves as a vital trade corridor where the
Raft-men of Thranduil's realm, the Men of Dale, and the merchants of Dorwinion
interact. The presence of the Dorwinion Road highlights its role as a bustling
mercantile highway, though its proximity to the wild edges of Mirkwood leaves
it vulnerable to stray orcs, spiders, and bandits preying on wealthy wine
caravans.
